description: This source file contains a fuzzing test for the Qpack encoder and decoder in the QUIC protocol implementation, including classes for encoding, decoding, and transmitting header blocks with simulated delays, as well as functions for generating and splitting header lists.

classes.name: EncodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackEncoder instance, handles header encoding, and manages stream sender delegate.

classes.name: DelayedHeaderBlockTransmitter
classes.description: Simulates delayed transmission of header blocks, with a nested Visitor interface for transmission events.

classes.name: VerifyingDecoder
classes.description: Decodes and verifies header blocks, ensuring they match expected headers, and handles asynchronous decoding.

classes.name: DecodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages QpackDecoder, creates VerifyingDecoders for header blocks, and tracks expected headers.

classes.name: DelayedStreamDataTransmitter
classes.description: Simulates delayed transmission of encoder/decoder stream data.

methods.name: TruncateValueOnInvalidChars
methods.description: Removes invalid characters (NUL, LF, CR) from a string.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderList
methods.description: Creates a header list with randomized headers based on fuzz data.

methods.name: SplitHeaderList
methods.description:
Splits header values along '
' or ';' separators into multiple headers.
